title: Silas and the Ledger
author: Marguerite Pemberton
blurb: Lior Zhou, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
